name: Facebook Community Sales OS - Social AIO Runtime
notes: Adds NHẬT KÝ IMPORT and THỐNG KÊ NGÀY with per-group daily scan/new/duplicate/lead counters.
New JSON rows are inserted at the top of NHẬP JSON, BÌNH LUẬN and CƠ HỘI.
Posts JSON can now expose nested comments; comments are parsed even when the parent post is already a duplicate.
Captures media CDN URLs into NHẬP JSON, BÌNH LUẬN and CƠ HỘI without embedding heavy inline images.
Adds consistency audit across raw posts, comments, opportunities, leads and group registry.
Fast refresh skips expensive full dedupe/remap during normal import/AI cycles.
AI input is compressed and AI result writes are batched to reduce tokens and Sheet RPC latency.
Lead rows persist first-lead date for accurate new-lead-per-day reporting.
